analysis.title: AstraZeneca (AZN.L): Relatively uneventful 3Q as focus remains on pipeline catalysts and 2027 dynamics
key_insights: GS rates AstraZeneca Buy and raises the 12m price target 6% to 17,580p (AZN.L) / $233 (AZN) from 16,601p / $220, driven by a valuation roll-forward of 3 months and a shift of the P/E base to 2028E EPS.

3Q26 revenue beat was modest and good quality, driven by growth assets with no notable one-offs or stocking benefits. The EPS beat was more mixed, helped by higher other operating income (OOI), which has limited external visibility, and by cost phasing.
Management gave little new colour on 2027 opex on the call and flagged only the known headwinds. The market read this as positive against expectations of more cautious margin commentary beyond 2026.

FY26 guidance reiterated: total revenue up mid- to high-single-digit % and Core EPS up low-double-digit %, both at CER. GS estimates (revenue $63,227mn, Core EPS $10.16) sit at the midpoints of the guidance ranges.

Catalysts through 2027 include oral PCSK9 laroprovstat (AZURE-LDL/AZURE-HeFH), multiple Datroway readouts, camizestrant/CAMBRIA-1 in adjuvant HR+ breast cancer, PARP1 inhibitor saruparib (EvoPAR-Prostate01) in prostate cancer, and balcinrenone or zibotentan plus Farxiga fixed-dose combinations (BalanceD-HF, ZENITH).

AVANZAR is now a multi-year overhang into 1Q27. GS sees expectations as rebased and reads the limited stock reaction to the delay as a sign the market will not overreact to a negative outcome. GS assumes a 40% probability of success.

Management reiterated that $20bn in peak sales revenue could be de-risked across 2027. GS says investors are less convinced by post-2030 growth, though it sees growth beyond 2030 as credible given pipeline breadth. GS thinks AZN's $80bn 2030 revenue target is achievable.

Some 2027 readouts, particularly the dapagliflozin fixed-dose combinations, are likely to be viewed as unexciting. GS sees a series of lower-profile Phase 3 successes as a path to restoring confidence in R&D and driving a re-rating.

Restructuring program (Reshaping for Sustainable Growth) targets $1.5bn annualized savings per year until the end of 2029, with one-time costs of up to $2bn. The savings will be reinvested in the business.

Product notes: Calquence is now the number 1 BTK inhibitor in CLL in the US. Tagrisso revenue crossed $2bn in a single quarter for the first time. Baxfendy's initial launch is strong across primary care and specialty physicians, with Medicare Part D coverage expected from 2028.

Headwinds flagged by management: generic erosion for Farxiga and Symbicort, Calquence IRA price negotiation, investment for new launches and continued R&D spend. Launches can take up to 4 years to break even depending on indication.
China's 2030 biotech ambition could raise competitive pressure but could also benefit AZN through its China presence and partnership strategy.

GS vs Visible Alpha consensus: broadly in line on revenue for FY26-31E and 5-22% ahead for FY32-35E. Core operating margin is 100-360bps lower in FY27-34E, and core EPS is 4-10% below in FY27-32E and 3-14% above in FY33-35.

market_movers.rationale: Price target raised from $220 on a valuation roll-forward. Valuation does not reflect the growth opportunity and multiple catalysts run through 2027. Upside is 24.8% from $186.65.

sector_views.rationale: GS rates AstraZeneca Buy within its European pharma coverage and sees valuation failing to reflect growth and pipeline catalysts.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 (reported, update on 2026-11-02 report): revenue beat was modest and came from growth assets with no one-offs or stocking benefit. The EPS beat was mixed because of higher other operating income and cost phasing. Quarterly EPS in the GS table: $2.61 (6/26) and $2.77 (9/26), GS estimate $2.15 for 12/26E.

FY26 guidance reiterated: revenue up mid- to high-single-digit % at CER, Core EPS up low-double-digit % at CER. Currency is a low single-digit tailwind on revenue and neutral on Core EPS, based on Sep 2026 FX rates.

GS estimates FY26E total revenue $63,227mn (guidance midpoint implies $63,383mn, company consensus $63,260mn). GS Core EPS estimate $10.16 (basis: Core EPS, GS estimate) vs company-compiled consensus $10.24 and a guidance midpoint implying $10.17. FY25A Core EPS was $9.16.
GS FY27E Core EPS is $10.92 vs Visible Alpha consensus $11.39 (4% below). GS FY27E core operating margin is 33.4% vs consensus 34.4%.
Revisions to estimates are minor: FY26E Core EPS $10.16 (old $10.08), FY27E $10.92 unchanged, FY28E $12.03 (old $12.05).

trade_ideas.description: Buy AstraZeneca (AZN.L / AZN) with 12m price target 17,580p / $233, 25.9% upside (24.8% for the ADR-listed AZN line)
trade_ideas.rationale: Valuation fails to reflect the growth opportunity and multiple high-potential catalysts run through 2027.
trade_ideas.risk: Clinical trial failure, commercial execution, pricing, competitive developments and patent exposure.

risk_factors: Clinical trial failure, including AVANZAR (GS assumes 40% probability of success).
Pricing, including Calquence IRA price negotiation.
Competitive developments, including China biotech competition and competitor launches against Tagrisso.
Patent exposure and generic erosion for Farxiga and Symbicort.
Launch investment and R&D spend could pressure margins in 2027 (launches can take up to 4 years to break even).
geopolitical: China's 2030 biotech ambition could increase competitive pressure on AZN while creating collaboration opportunities through AZN's China presence and partnership strategy.

tension_points.bull_case: Management gave limited incremental commentary on 2027 opex, which the market took as positive. Multiple catalysts through 2027 and $20bn of peak sales potentially de-risked in 2027 support a re-rating.
tension_points.bear_case: Investors are less convinced by post-2030 growth. Headwinds include generic erosion for Farxiga and Symbicort, Calquence IRA pricing, launch investment, and GS's own consensus-below margin and EPS estimates for FY27-32E.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A negative AVANZAR outcome (GS assumes 40% probability of success, readout now a multi-year overhang into 1Q27).
